DIV8.HEAD: § 365.119 Opposed applications.
DIV8.P: If the application is opposed, opposing parties are required to send a copy of their protest to the applicant and to FMCSA. All protests must include statements made under oath (verified statements). There are no personal appearances or formal hearings.

EFFDNOT.PSPACE: At 82 FR 5300, Jan. 17, 2017, § 365.119 was suspended, effective Jan. 14, 2017.
